criteria.notes: Workforce wall: per-agent status, handled and presented counts, average talk time, plus aggregate ready/active/attention/offline counters.
Operations status-wall concept retained: uniform agent cards with a colour-coded state rail down the left edge.
Reads as a contact-centre wall rather than a generic KPI dashboard; the state rail and per-agent metric triplet are domain-specific.
Agent names hold the primary role; metric values and labels sit at their intended roles now that auto-fit resolves rather than pinning to the floor.
Dark-theme and grouping scenarios preserve state-rail hue separation and keep metric text legible against the card field.
Long-label and descender-title scenarios keep agent names complete; the descender scenario specifically confirms no baseline clipping.
The card grid fills the wall at full counts. Partially filled final pages leave empty cells, which is correct paging behaviour, and the empty state substitutes a centred message.
Agent initials discs and state rails render crisply from 600x600 through 1920x1080; no raster media involved.
The state-railed agent card wall is structurally distinct from the panel and table examples.
